subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Cancer epidemiology, prevention and screening: national registries, viral oncogenesis and evidence-based screening

steps.tx: National population-based registries delineate the distinct geographic burden of malignant disease in India. Current **GLOBOCAN** and **National Cancer Registry** Programme reports demonstrate that breast adenocarcinoma is the leading cancer diagnosis among Indian women, followed by cervical and oral cavity cancers. In urban metros, breast cancer accounts for over 30% of female malignancies, whereas rural registries maintain a persistently high incidence of advanced cervical carcinoma.
steps.say: National population-based registries delineate the distinct geographic burden of malignant disease in India. Current GLOBOCAN and National Cancer Registry Programme reports demonstrate that breast adenocarcinoma is the leading cancer diagnosis among Indian women, followed by cervical and oral cavity cancers. In urban centres, breast cancer accounts for over 30% of female malignancies.

steps.tx: Carcinogen exposure patterns explain the dramatic predominance of aerodigestive tract malignancies across South Asia. **Tobacco consumption** in both smoked and **smokeless** forms such as gutka, khaini, and betel quid with areca nut is responsible for over 40% of all cancers in Indian men. Smokeless tobacco delivers massive nitrosamine concentrations directly to buccal mucosa, producing severe oral leukoplakia, submucous fibrosis, and invasive gingivobuccal sulcus carcinomas.
steps.say: Carcinogen exposure patterns explain the dramatic predominance of aerodigestive tract malignancies across South Asia. Tobacco consumption in both smoked and smokeless forms such as gutka and betel quid is responsible for over 40% of all cancers in Indian men. Smokeless tobacco delivers tobacco-specific nitrosamines directly to buccal mucosa, causing aggressive oral cancers.

right.title: Smoked Tobacco (Bidi / Cigarette)

steps.tx: Secondary prevention through population-based screening aims to identify high-grade cervical dysplasia prior to invasive transformation. **Cervical cancer screening** guidelines from the World Health Organization recommend primary **HPV DNA testing** every 5 years for women aged 30 to 49 years. In low-resource public healthcare infrastructure lacking molecular diagnostic facilities, visual inspection with acetic acid VIA provides an accessible point-of-care screening alternative.
steps.say: Secondary prevention through population-based screening aims to identify high-grade cervical dysplasia prior to invasive transformation. Cervical cancer screening guidelines from the World Health Organization recommend primary HPV DNA testing every 5 years for women aged 30 to 49 years. In resource-constrained settings, visual inspection with acetic acid VIA provides an accessible alternative.

steps.tx: Routine radiological screening for breast malignancy substantially lowers stage at initial presentation. Screening **mammography** produces a proven 20% to 30% reduction in disease-specific mortality and is recommended biennially for **average-risk women** aged 50 to 74 years. For high-risk women with germline BRCA mutations or lifetime risk exceeding 20%, annual contrast-enhanced breast MRI screening begins at age 25 to 30 years alongside annual mammography.

right.title: High-Risk (BRCA1/2 / Lifetime >20%)
points: Annual breast contrast MRI starting age 25-30
Screening initiated 10 years before earliest family case
High sensitivity overcomes dense fibroglandular tissue

steps.tx: These mammogram views show a **spiculated mass** with clustered **microcalcifications** visible in CC and MLO projections of the breast. Such findings typify cancers found by **screening mammography** in average risk women. Detecting disease at this early imaging stage matters because routine biennial screening lowers breast cancer deaths and prompts timely diagnostic workup and treatment.
steps.say: These mammogram images in CC and MLO views show a spiculated invasive mass with clustered pleomorphic microcalcifications. The lesson places this in population screening for average risk women with biennial mammography, shown to lower breast cancer mortality. Seeing these classic signs helps explain why screening finds cancer before symptoms and allows earlier treatment with better outcomes.

steps.tx: Lung cancer screening using low-radiation tomographic imaging detects early, resectable peripheral pulmonary nodules. Annual **low-dose helical CT** screening in asymptomatic heavy smokers aged 50 to 80 years with at least a 20 pack-year history significantly reduces lung cancer mortality by 20% to 24%. These findings were definitively established in the landmark **NLST** and European NELSON randomized prospective screening trials.

These benefits were proven in the landmark NLST and NELSON trials.

steps.tx: Early detection of adenomatous polyps interrupts the classical adenoma-carcinoma sequence. Population-level **colorectal cancer screening** utilizing screening colonoscopy every 10 years or annual high-sensitivity **fecal immunochemical testing** FIT starting at age 45 years significantly reduces both cancer incidence and mortality. Detection of occult globin by FIT triggers definitive optical colonoscopy to resect dysplastic adenomas before malignant invasion occurs.
steps.say: Early detection of adenomatous polyps interrupts the classical adenoma-carcinoma sequence. Population-level colorectal cancer screening utilizing screening colonoscopy every 10 years or annual high-sensitivity fecal immunochemical testing FIT starting at age 45 years significantly reduces both cancer incidence and mortality. Positive FIT triggers optical colonoscopy.

steps.tx: Primary prevention through immunization against oncogenic viruses eliminates virus-induced cellular transformation. Routine **HPV vaccination** targeting high-risk genotypes 16 and 18 provides robust **primary prevention** against cervical, anal, vulvovaginal, and oropharyngeal carcinomas. Administered as a single-dose or two-dose schedule in adolescent girls aged 9 to 14 years before sexual debut, vaccine efficacy against vaccine-type persistent HPV infection exceeds 95%.

Routine HPV vaccination targeting high-risk genotypes 16 and 18 provides robust primary prevention against cervical, anal, vulvovaginal, and oropharyngeal carcinomas. steps.tx: Chronic necroinflammation driven by viral persistence is an entirely preventable cause of primary liver malignancy. Universal infant **hepatitis B vaccination** blocks chronic hepatitis B virus infection, directly decreasing childhood and adult **hepatocellular carcinoma** incidence by over 75%. In parallel, curative direct-acting antiviral therapy against hepatitis C virus achieves sustained virological response exceeding 95%, sharply reducing downstream cirrhosis and malignant transformation.
steps.say: Chronic necroinflammation driven by viral persistence is an entirely preventable cause of primary liver malignancy. Universal infant hepatitis B vaccination blocks chronic hepatitis B virus infection, directly decreasing childhood and adult hepatocellular carcinoma incidence by over 75%. Curative direct-acting antivirals for hepatitis C achieve similar long-term protective effects.
